auditType: targeted Section B answer-pattern and assessment-coverage remediation

permutation.algorithm: For each question ID, SHA-256(seed + "|" + questionId) supplies three Fisher–Yates draws over [0,1,2,3]. The resulting order is applied to the option array and the correct index is remapped by the same order.
